numeral.purpose: Case number in the departures strip.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour and opacity changes on hover, focus and menus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #F2B33D; color: #0E1A2B; font: 600 14px 'Readex Pro', sans-serif; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #DE9A1A; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D3A63; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Repeated list actions and secondary choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #14181F; font: 600 14px 'Readex Pro', sans-serif; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #DDE1E7; border-radius: 8px; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F9FAFB; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D3A63; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search by name or case number">
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fff; color: #14181F; font: 400 14px 'Readex Pro', sans-serif; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #DDE1E7; border-radius: 8px; caret-color: #1D3A63; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D3A63; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Countdown Chip
components.description: Split-flap countdown for a legal deadline.
components.html: 24 days remaining Overdue Done
components.css: .ds-flap { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 12.8px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .025em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #E8EDF5; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #0A1422 0 49%, #050B14 49% 51%, #0A1422 51% 100%); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-flap-late { color: #FF8A8D; } .ds-flap-ok { color: #7ED7B5; }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Midnight navigation bar with the current page in amber.
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; height: 64px; align-items: stretch; gap: 4px; padding: 0 24px; background: #0E1A2B; font: 500 14px 'Readex Pro', sans-serif; } .ds-topbar a { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px; color: #A9B6C9; text-decoration: none; position: relative; } .ds-topbar a:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-topbar a.ds-on { color: #F2B33D; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #F2B33D; }

components.name: Route Rail
components.description: Five case stages as stations on one line.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); list-style: none; padding: 0; font: 400 13px 'Readex Pro', sans-serif; color: #9CA3AF; text-align: center; } .ds-rail li::before { content: ''; display: block; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin: 0 auto 8px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #DDE1E7; background: #fff; } .ds-rail .ds-done { color: #4B5563; } .ds-rail .ds-done::before { border-color: #0E1A2B; background: #0E1A2B; } .ds-rail .ds-now { color: #14181F; font-weight: 600; } .ds-rail .ds-now::before { border-color: #F2B33D; background: #F2B33D; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #FDF3DD; }

narrative.overview: Displanery reads like the departures board at Baghdad Central Station. A disciplinary case is a timetable: what is due next, from which stage, and how long until it leaves. The midnight board hangs overhead; everything below it is a calm, light working ground.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight shell overhead, light #F2F4F7 working ground below.
Deadlines are always the most visible thing on a working screen.
Amber appears at most twice per screen: the current station and the primary action.
One interface family (Readex Pro) for Arabic and Latin; JetBrains Mono only for numbers that are measured or counted.
Right-to-left is native: every layout mirrors with logical properties.

rules.name: The Two Amber Points Rule
rules.body: On any screen, signal amber appears on at most the current stage and the one primary action. Repeated list actions use the secondary button.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only State Rule
rules.body: Red, green and ochre appear only where they carry a deadline or status meaning, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Measured Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono is for numbers that are counted or measured (case numbers, dates, countdowns, counts), never for labels or decoration.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase kicker above a heading; the heading speaks for itself.

dos: Do put the deadlines of a case or list first, as a departures strip or board with countdown chips.
Do keep amber to the current station and the single primary action (The Two Amber Points Rule).
Do set every case number, date and countdown in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do use logical properties so every layout mirrors for Arabic.
donts: Don't use a generic SaaS look: purple gradients, oversized rounded cards, glassy surfaces.
Don't use playful or decorative colour; colour carries state or action only.
Don't imitate old government styling (heavy borders, seals, crests).
Don't cram content: keep 20px panel padding and readable line lengths.
Don't put a small uppercase eyebrow above a heading.
